ambient_events: Something heavy settles inside a container and goes quiet.
The hook comes down toward the water, hangs there, and starts back up.
Out past the fenders the channel runs black and does not give anything back.
description: The outer end of the quay. A short stack of containers going green at the seams, a rail beam let into the slab, and the second crane sitting with its boom swung out over the basin. The hook comes down, waits, and goes back up again on nothing.
name: Basin Quay
